# Shared element transitions

[← Layout transitions](layout_transitions.md) · [All examples](../EXAMPLES.md) · [CSS animations →](css_animations.md)

A tile flies to the next screen and back.

Reanimated docs: [shared-element-transitions/overview](https://docs.swmansion.com/react-native-reanimated/docs/shared-element-transitions/overview)

## What to look at

- The same `sharedTransitionTag` on both screens; DartNative's `Hero` runs the flight.

## Code

The screen comes first, then the components it uses. Shared helpers (`DemoPage`, `Section`, `Stage`, `Palette`, `Buttons`, `ChoiceChips`, `LabeledSlider`) live in `example_app/lib/src/common/` and only do layout.

### `lib/src/screens/shared_element_screen.dart`

```dart
import 'package:dartnative/dartnative.dart';
import 'package:reanimated_dartnative/reanimated_dartnative.dart';

import '../common/common.dart';
import 'shared_element_detail_screen.dart';

/// docs/shared-element-transitions/overview: a tile flies to the next screen
/// and back. `sharedTransitionTag` matches views across a push.
class SharedElementScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const SharedElementScreen({super.key});

  static const colors = [Palette.purple, Palette.blue, Palette.pink, Palette.yellow];

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => DemoPage(
        title: 'Shared element transitions',
        docs: 'shared-element-transitions/overview',
        child: Wrap(
          spacing: 16,
          runSpacing: 16,
          children: [
            for (var i = 0; i < colors.length; i++)
              GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).push(PageRoute(builder: (_) => SharedElementDetailScreen(index: i))),
                child: AnimatedView(
                  sharedTransitionTag: 'tile-$i',
                  style: AnimatedStyle(width: 150, height: 150, backgroundColor: colors[i], borderRadius: 16),
                ),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}
```

### `lib/src/screens/shared_element_detail_screen.dart`

```dart
import 'package:dartnative/dartnative.dart';
import 'package:reanimated_dartnative/reanimated_dartnative.dart';

import 'shared_element_screen.dart';

/// The second screen of the shared element transition.
class SharedElementDetailScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const SharedElementDetailScreen({super.key, required this.index});
  final int index;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(title: Text('Tile ${index + 1}')),
        body: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            AnimatedView(
              sharedTransitionTag: 'tile-$index',
              style: AnimatedStyle(height: 320, backgroundColor: SharedElementScreen.colors[index], borderRadius: 0),
            ),
            const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.all(16),
              child: Text('Go back to see the tile return to its place.'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}
```
